title: Bottomry loans for voyages with Spain, the Spanish Americas, and the Caribbean as main destinations, 1597-1699 dataset
descriptions: This dataset was constructed during the NWO VICI project ‘Exploiting the Empires of Others: Dutch Investment in Foreign Colonial Resources, 1570-1800’ at Leiden University. The data consists of bottomry loans (bodemerijen) found in the notarial archive of the Amsterdam City Archives.
